description: Draft one or more posts into a ProductClank content space. FREE. Call get_content_workspace FIRST and write in that brand's voice, post types and topics — the drafts are scored against exactly that voice by the reviewer a moment after they land, and the scores show in get_content_queue. `platform` must be one of the space's platforms (omit it to use the first). Candidates land in the user's 'All Content' queue for approval; nothing is auto-published. Up to 25 per call. This drafts into the user's OWN content pipeline — it is NOT a community content campaign (use create_content_campaign for that).

template.description: Content template, e.g. "Build-in-Public" or "Proof Point". Defaults to Build-in-Public.

title.description: Short internal label / topic for the draft.

space_id.description: Target content space UUID from list_content_spaces.

name: write_content_candidates
title: Draft content candidates
